modules.title: TotemCore
modules.description: Shared APIs, unified manuals, exact client/server version checks, events, and legacy ID migration for the Totem ecosystem.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemCore 0.5.0 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Provides the shared v1 API, event bus, manual framework, compatibility checks, and migration contracts used by the current Totem modules.

gallery.title: Totem ecosystem integration
gallery.description: The shared Core contracts and ten-module DeadRecall 2.4.10 integration map.

modules.title: TotemRemnant
modules.description: Tiered modular backpacks, death-item recovery, soulbound retention, and portable-container safety for Fabric survival.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemRemnant 0.2.10 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Includes four backpack tiers, modular upgrades, server-authoritative death backpacks, soulbound retention, ownership rules, and portable-container safety.

gallery.title: Backpack inventory panel
gallery.description: The carried backpack appears beside the vanilla inventory for a quick read-only view.

gallery.title: Backpack upgrade bay
gallery.description: The one-row module bay and integrated 3 by 3 crafting area.

gallery.title: Capacity upgrades
gallery.description: Four capacity modules expand a backpack with four additional storage rows.

modules.title: TotemAutomata
modules.description: Give Copper Golems server-authoritative sorting and gathering jobs with tools, fuel, storage routes, and configurable targets.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemAutomata 0.1.11 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Adds copper-wrench configuration, bounded sorting and gathering jobs, tool and fuel handling, manual rules, and optional OpenAI-compatible classification.

modules.title: TotemNexus
modules.description: Build material-driven Space Units for lodestone travel, maps, friends, safe routes, and optional death recovery.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemNexus 0.2.5 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Includes material-driven Space Units, server-quoted travel, maps, discovery, favorites, friends, safe landings, and optional death-node recovery.

gallery.title: Space Unit materials
gallery.description: Material-driven capacity, stability, route, and cross-dimensional travel diagnostics.

modules.title: TotemDiscordBridge
modules.description: Relay chat, player activity, server events, attachments, audits, and live status to Discord through a configurable HTTPS Worker.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemDiscordBridge 0.1.5 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Relays configured chat, player activity, server lifecycle, Totem events, audits, attachments, and status through a separately deployed HTTPS Worker.

modules.title: TotemAlchemy
modules.description: Turn cauldrons and brewing stands into dynamic alchemy with discoverable ingredients, multiple outcomes, and custom brews.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemAlchemy 0.1.22 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Adds heated cauldron production, dynamic multi-outcome brewing, discovery records, pig manure, saltpeter, gunpowder, hot cocoa, and custom potion families.

gallery.title: Alchemy ingredients
gallery.description: Alchemy ingredients, vessels, and custom brews available in DeadRecall 2.4.10.

modules.title: TotemEnchanting
modules.description: Make Chiseled Bookshelves contribute content-based enchanting power, scaling beyond vanilla with clear particle feedback.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemEnchanting 0.1.4 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Makes Chiseled Bookshelves contribute content-based power up to 64 with a vanilla-compatible quality curve and visual feedback.

modules.title: Totem Excavation
modules.description: Mine controlled areas with seven tiers of server-authoritative hammers and reusable per-stack selection rules.
modules.changelog: Standalone Totem Excavation 0.1.1 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Adds seven hammer tiers, reusable per-stack corner selections, bounded server-side area mining, and a local selection outline.

modules.title: TotemVanillaTweaks
modules.description: Focused Fabric improvements for container sorting, recipes, bookshelf rules, concrete hardening, and furnace experience.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemVanillaTweaks 0.1.7 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Adds server-validated container sorting, a Lectern recipe, survival Bookshelf rules, Concrete Powder hardening, and automated furnace experience recovery.

modules.title: Totem Villagers
modules.description: A server-authoritative village economy where villagers carry real stock, work, craft, trade, build, and manage resources.
modules.changelog: Standalone Totem Villagers 0.1.22 from DeadRecall 2.4.10. Adds a physical work-backed economy, real profession production, protected inventories, builders, guards, work zones, resource chains, and mangrove villages.

gallery.title: Mangrove village
gallery.description: A terrain-aware generated mangrove village with integrated production areas.
